releaseNotes: Works offline: your sets save without internet and sync when you're back online.
Workout mode with supersets, last session's sets and the change on every set.
Plates, bodyweight, per-side and left/right sets.
Personal records, workout history and a shareable summary card.
Warm-up and rest-pause sets, tempo, plate calculator and next-set suggestions.
Weekly goal, streak and deload reminders.
Body measurements with trends and insights.
Rest timer on the lock screen and a new icon.
